WaterDemandNorms2.name: Residential Area – Independent Residential House / Builder Floor / Apartment / Flat / Group Housing / Residential Colony
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Residential norm. Occupancy is 5 persons per dwelling unit (DU). A plot has 1 DU per kitchen, subject to a minimum of 1 DU per floor. Total water demand is 225 LPCD: 180 LPCD potable and 45 LPCD non-potable. The revised sheet states that DDA Flat IFC charges are zero.

ifcExceptions.reason: The revised norms sheet states that IFC charges for DDA Flat cannot be calculated and shall be zero.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: School / Academic Area of Colleges
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is the higher of (i) 1 person per 4 sqm of built-up area or (ii) where the school/college functions in two shifts, the total strength including students and staff of both shifts. Academic area means dedicated floor space used directly for teaching and academic instruction, such as classrooms, lecture halls, libraries and laboratories. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand is more than 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand. Institutional is the top-level property category for B-1.
WaterDemandNorms2.builtUpAreaDefinition: Built-up area / Gross Floor Area is the area of the floor within the inside perimeter of the outside walls. No deductions are made for corridors and passageways, stairs, closets, thickness of interior walls, columns, lifts, building shafts or other features.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Mercantile / Assembly
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is 1 person per 4.5 sqm of built-up area. The norm covers the mercantile and assembly uses listed in the revised DJB sheet. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC basis differs by use class: Mercantile uses potable requirement only when total demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; Assembly uses total water demand. The top-level property category for all B-2 property types is Commercial; Mercantile and Assembly are B-2 use classes, not Institutional property categories.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Commercial / Industrial
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is 1 person per 10 sqm of built-up area. This includes the commercial and industrial uses listed in the revised sheet, including offices, banks, professional establishments, police stations, private clinics without IPD/bed facilities, laboratories, research establishments, diagnostic centres, libraries, test houses, telephone/broadcasting/TV stations, assembly plants, industrial laboratories, dry-cleaning plants, pumping stations, laundries, bottling/soft-drink plants, biogas plants, general industrial units and ice-cream factories. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Storage / Multilevel Parking / Cremation or Burial Ground / Golf Course / Sports Complex
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is 1 person per 30 sqm of built-up area. This includes warehouses, cold storage, freight depots, electric substations/distribution grids, approved multilevel parking, cremation/burial grounds, golf courses, sports complexes and stadiums. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Hotels Below 3 Star / Hostels / Dormitories / Lodging / Custodial / Penal and Behavioural Health Institutions / Orphanages / Dharamshalas / Destitute and Charitable Homes / Paying Guest Accommodation / Guest Houses / Bed and Breakfast / Ashram / Resorts / Motels
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Use the number of beds specified in the sanctioned/approved plan, or 1 bed per 7.5 sqm of built-up area, whichever is higher. Water demand is 180 LPCD per bed: 135 LPCD potable and 45 LPCD non-potable. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand.
WaterDemandNorms2.builtUpAreaDefinition: Built-up area / Gross Floor Area is the area of the floor within the inside perimeter of the outside walls. WaterDemandNorms2.name: Hotels 3 Star and Above
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Use sanctioned/specifically specified bed count wherever provided. If bed count is not specified, occupancy is the higher of 2 beds per room or 1 bed per 12.5 sqm of built-up area. Water demand is 320 LPCD per bed: 275 LPCD potable and 45 LPCD non-potable. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Restaurants / Canteens / Pantries
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is 1 person per 1.5 sqm of built-up area. Total water demand is 70 LPCD: 15 LPCD potable and 55 LPCD non-potable. Add 10% of total calculated water demand as floating/contingency occupancy. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Nursing Homes / Hospitals
WaterDemandNorms2.description: C-4 primary bed occupancy is determined only by the number of beds specified in the sanctioned building plan / property record. Built-up area is not used to derive or replace the bed count in the water-demand occupancy calculation. For up to 100 beds, bed demand is 340 LPCD per bed (250 potable + 90 non-potable); above 100 beds, bed demand is 450 LPCD per bed (360 potable + 90 non-potable). Add OPD occupancy separately as the higher of one person per 1.5 sqm of OPD-earmarked area or 20 persons per bed; OPD demand is 15 LPCD potable. Add 10% of total calculated water demand, including OPD, as floating/contingency occupancy. Hospital / Nursing Home applicability continues to be determined by plot area: Hospital at 2,500 sqm or more; Nursing Home up to 2,500 sqm. IFC charges use potable requirement only when total water demand exceeds 12,500 LPD; otherwise use total demand.
WaterDemandNorms2.clarificationNote: The source workbook also contains a remark about minimum beds per built-up area (1 bed/80 sqm for hospitals and 1 bed/60 sqm for nursing homes). This implementation follows the explicit implementation instruction that C-4 bed occupancy must be calculated only from Number of Beds; the built-up-area minimum is therefore not applied. Separately, exactly 2,500 sqm satisfies both supplied plot-area conditions; confirm that boundary with DJB.
